summary: Instruct agent to set appropriately longer durations for tests, builds, and data processing scripts rather than prematurely short ones

edits.hypothesis: Encouraging appropriate longer durations for heavy commands like training and testing helps prevent premature truncation and lets the agent see full test output and tracebacks.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions in templates directly guide model duration selection and planning behavior.
edits.retroactive_check: corrective: bn-fit-modify would have more complete output logs to debug assertions; preservative: does not affect fast tasks; transfer: generalizes across any long-running compilation or training task.
edits.mechanism: Encouraging appropriate longer durations for heavy commands like training and testing helps prevent premature truncation and lets the agent see full test output and tracebacks.
